# Project Templates

Reusable templates for CMS project tracking.

| Template | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `TASK_TEMPLATE.md` | Standard implementation/decision task |
| `BUG_TEMPLATE.md` | Bug report and fix tracking |
| `FEATURE_TEMPLATE.md` | Product feature proposal |
| `RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` | Release readiness and rollback checklist |

Use these alongside `CMS_TASK_TRACKING.md` and the generated Excel workbook.
